afirmacion: En 2020 Marruecos subio el NMF de bienes finales de 25% a 40%; aplica sobre todo a Asia, revirtio parte del TLC con Turquia y responde a medidas de sustitucion de importaciones
cita_textual: raise applied most-favored nation (MFN) tariffs on finished goods from 25% to 40% | Morocco's MFN Tariffs—which apply chiefly to trading partners in Asia—were increased to 30% in January 2020 and to 40% in July of the same year. Some of the tariff reductions agreed under the Morocco-Turkey Free Trade Agreement were also reversed. ... prompting the adoption of ambitious import-substituting measures. Although the recent tariff hikes affect less than 20% of merchandise imports, ... they increase the Kingdom's dependence on the EU market by raising EU preferences.
emisor: Banco Mundial y Policy Center for the New South, Sauve y Dadush (eds.), Trade Policy in Morocco: Taking Stock and Looking Ahead
nota: No nombra productos; coincide con lo observado en 8708: maximo NMF 40%, Turquia con 36% en 5 lineas, el grupo que paga NMF es 74% China
